# Ghost.js

> Compiler-first reactive JavaScript framework distributed as an npm workspace monorepo.

Ghost.js provides reactive primitives, a template compiler, routing, HTTP helpers, events, data adapters, and a CLI. Its mobile build emits a single-file WebView bundle. Native Android hosting and native plugins belong to the separate Specter Bridge project.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, install, CLI usage, and framework packages.
- [Mobile and WebView builds](docs/MOBILE.md): `ghost build --target=mobile`, output layout, asset requirements, and WebView notes.
- [Signals](docs/SIGNALS.md): reactive core concepts.
- [Router](docs/ROUTER.md): routing behavior.
- [HTTP](docs/HTTP.md): network helpers.
- [Bridge](docs/BRIDGE.md): Ghost's browser persistence helper (`persistSignal`).
- [Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md): release history.

## Repository layout

- `packages/core`: reactive runtime and browser persistence.
- `packages/compiler`: template compiler and build pipeline.
- `packages/ghost-cli`: project generator, dev server, and build commands.
- `packages/router`, `packages/events`, `packages/database`, `packages/paradigms`: supporting packages.
- `demo-app`: framework example.

## Common commands

- `npm install`: install workspace dependencies.
- `npm test`: run package tests.
- `npm run size`: check the configured core bundle-size limit.
- `ghost build --target=mobile`: produce `dist/build/index.html` and `dist/build/bundle.js` for a WebView host.

## Native Android

Ghost.js builds the web UI. For native Android hosting, plugin transport, and setup instructions, see [Specter Bridge](https://github.com/jarir2020/specter-bridge) and its [Ghost.js integration guide](https://github.com/jarir2020/specter-bridge/blob/main/docs/ghostjs-integration.md).
